print.guide.step1: Scan the QR code shown in the kiosk to open the upload page on your device.
print.guide.step2: Upload your document file(s) from your device.
print.guide.step3: Press "Send to Kiosk" to transfer your file(s) to the kiosk.
print.guide.step4: See your file(s) uploaded to the kiosk. If you are ready to proceed, press "Continue to Print Options" for the next step.
print.guide.step5: You can modify your print settings (e.g. number of copies, color or black & white) and then press "Next Step" to insert coins.
print.guide.step6: You may now proceed inserting coins.
print.guide.step7: If the amount you inserted is sufficient, "Confirm & Print" will be enabled.
print.guide.step8: Kiosk may warn you about checking the printer paper tray. Make sure the paper you want to print on is loaded in the tray, loaded straight, and not jammed.
print.guide.step9: Another reconfirmation of print details may be shown. If everything is correct, press "Print Now" to start printing.
print.guide.step10: The printer is processed in background.
print.guide.step11: After transaction, an optional E-Receipt QR code is shown for your convenience. You may scan it to download a soft copy of the receipt. You may use it to report issues or request refunds if needed.
copy.guide.step1: Place your document face-down first on the scanner glass. Choose first what document size of the physical document you want to copy. If it is ready, press "Check Document" on the kiosk screen to preview the scan.
copy.guide.step2: Please wait for your document to finish scanning.
copy.guide.step3: Review the scanned preview on the screen. If it is correct, press "Continue to Config" for the next step.
copy.guide.step4: You can modify your print settings (e.g. number of copies, color or black & white) and then press "Next Step" to insert coins.
copy.guide.step5: Insert the required coins for your copy job and confirm payment.
copy.guide.step6: Kiosk may warn you about checking the printer paper tray. Make sure the paper you want to print on is loaded in the tray, loaded straight, and not jammed.
copy.guide.step7: Another reconfirmation of copy details may be shown. If everything is correct, press "Copy Now" to start copying.
copy.guide.step8: The printer is processed in background.
copy.guide.step9: After transaction, an optional E-Receipt QR code is shown for your convenience. You may scan it to download a soft copy of the receipt. You may use it to report issues or request refunds if needed. Make sure to pick up your original physical document from the scanner glass or document feeder after transaction.
scan.guide.step1: Place your document face-down first on the feeder. Choose first what document size of the physical document you want to convert as soft copy, as well as the soft copy file format. If it is ready, press "Scan Document" on the kiosk screen.
scan.guide.step2: Your physical document is feeding into the printer. Please wait for it to finish scanning.
scan.guide.step3: Your scanned document will appear on the kiosk screen. Review the preview.
scan.guide.step4: Insert the required coins for your scan job and confirm payment.
scan.guide.step5: Press "Download Now" to download the scanned document. Make sure that your device is connected to the kiosk Wi-Fi hotspot to download the scanned document.
scan.guide.step6: You may now scan the Download File and/or E-Receipt QR codes to download a soft copy of the scanned document and/or receipt. You may use the receipt to report issues or request refunds if needed.
scan.guide.step7: Your downloaded feeded document are now available to your mobile device as an soft copy. Make sure to pick up your original physical document from the scanner glass or document feeder after transaction.
